comparison.objective: Bimanually hang a cabinet by engaging a French cleat, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Level load carrying and full-length cleat alignment differ from fine hex access, captive-screw handling, collar adjustment, and iterative dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires the cabinet hanging level and released without tipping; the candidate requires two safe axial carriage stops at a locked, stable setting.
comparison.reason: Mechanical engagement is shared only abstractly; cabinet alignment and load support do not duplicate damper commissioning.
